item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 7:54 PM, 09 October 2026(Friday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bulacan (Dona Remedios Trinidad and Norzagaray), Nueva Ecija (Gabaldon, Cabiao, San Antonio, Jaen, Santa Rosa, Aliaga, Licab, Cabanatuan, Quezon, Santo Domingo, Llanera, General Mamerto Natividad, Guimba, Palayan, and General Tinio), Pampanga (Angeles, Mexico, Arayat, San Fernando, Bacolor, Floridablanca, Santa Ana, Santa Rita, Porac, and Guagua), Quezon (Perez, Quezon, Lopez, Unisan, Pitogo, Macalelon, Atimonan, Plaridel, Agdangan, Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Calauag, Buenavista, General Luna, Catanauan, Real, Infanta, and Mauban), Rizal (Rodriguez, Tanay, and Antipolo), Tarlac (La Paz, San Jose, Gerona, and Victoria), and Zambales (Botolan and San Marcelino) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Nueva Ecija (Zaragoza and Talavera), Pampanga (Mabalacat and Magalang), Quezon (Alabat, Gumaca, and General Nakar), and Tarlac (Tarlac City, Capas, Concepcion, and Bamban) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
